newsitem.title: USA: Quaker State settlement costs reserved.
newsitem.headline: Quaker State settlement costs reserved.

text.p: Quaker State Corp said Wednesday the amounts to satisfy the announced settlement of environmental charges are provided for in the company's environmental reserves.

The settlement with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency and Justice Department regarding issues at the company's Congo Refinery in West Virginia was announced Tuesday by those agencies. As a result of the settlement a Consent Decree was lodged Tuesday in U.S. District Court for the Northern District of West Virginia.

In summary, Quaker State said, it agreed to a $2.9 million assessment to be satisfied by supplemental environmental projects amounting to about $1.2 million in combination with a monetary payment of about $1.7 million.
The Congo Refinery has already begun work towards compliance with the Consent Decree, in order to expedite this process, Quaker State said.
